dead-hang.seqNote: seen from the side, in profile; the bar is a plain pull-up bar on a simple steel frame with no cable, pulley or weight stack; the low step stays on the floor under the feet in BOTH panels: in the LEFT panel the feet stand on it, in the RIGHT panel they hang just above it, ready to step back down

gripper.name: Hand gripper
gripper.setup: close-up of one forearm and hand holding a hand gripper (two handles joined by a coiled spring)
gripper.start: fingers curled around the front handle and the back handle across the palm, the handles held apart by the spring, the hand half closed
gripper.end: hand squeezed shut so the handles touch
gripper.path: a short curved arrow beside the fingertips: its tail at the front handle and its head pointing in toward the palm and the back handle, showing the fingers squeezing the two handles together
gripper.seqNote: the same hand from the same angle in both panels, the palm toward the camera and the fingers wrapped around the front handle; in the LEFT panel the handles are apart in a V, in the RIGHT panel the fist is closed and the handles touch; the fingers are never flat or straight

plate-pinch.name: Plate pinch
plate-pinch.setup: two pairs of smooth weight plates, each pair stood together with the smooth sides out and pinched along the top rim between the flat thumb on one side and the flat mitten hand on the other
plate-pinch.start: squatting with a flat back between the two pairs of plates, each hand pinching one pair along its rim
plate-pinch.end: standing tall holding a pinched pair of plates beside each leg, arms straight, shoulders down
plate-pinch.path: an upward arrow beside the plates as they are lifted

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.setup: standing tall holding one heavy dumbbell in one hand at the side, the other arm relaxed
suitcase-carry.start: standing tall holding the dumbbell at one side, shoulders level
suitcase-carry.end: walking forward mid-stride, torso upright and not leaning toward the weight
suitcase-carry.path: a long straight arrow low beside the feet pointing in the walking direction

bird-dog.name: Bird dog
bird-dog.setup: on hands and knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat
bird-dog.start: on all fours, back flat, head in line with the spine
bird-dog.end: one arm and the opposite leg extended straight out, level with the back, hips and shoulders square
bird-dog.path: beside the moving leg, from the knee on the floor back to the extended leg

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.setup: lying on the back on the floor, arms pointing straight up at the ceiling, hips and knees bent 90 degrees with the shins level with the floor, lower back pressed to the floor
dead-bug.start: arms up, knees over the hips, shins level
dead-bug.end: one arm lowered back overhead and the opposite leg extended straight out just above the floor, lower back still flat
dead-bug.path: beside the extending leg, from the bent knee out to the straight leg just above the floor

plank.name: Plank
plank.setup: forearms on the floor under the shoulders, feet together on the toes
plank.start: knees resting on the floor, forearms down, back flat
plank.end: knees lifted so the body is one straight line from head to heels on the forearms and toes, hips level
plank.path: a short upward arrow under the hips as the knees lift into the line

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.setup: lying on one side, propped on the forearm with the elbow under the shoulder, legs straight and stacked
side-plank.start: hips resting on the floor, body straight
side-plank.end: hips lifted so the body forms one straight line from head to feet, top hand on the hip
side-plank.path: a short upward arrow under the hips

machine-crunch.name: Abdominal crunch machine
machine-crunch.machine: a seated pin-loaded abdominal crunch machine: a seat with a back pad, two handles above the shoulders on a lever that pivots forward and down, padded foot rollers, a weight stack
machine-crunch.setup: seat set so the handles sit just above the shoulders; feet hooked under the rollers; hands holding the handles beside the head
machine-crunch.start: torso upright against the back pad, hands at the handles beside the head
machine-crunch.end: torso curled forward and down, ribs pulled toward the pelvis, chin tucked, the lever brought down by the trunk rather than the arms
machine-crunch.path: an arc in front of the chest and face that curves forward and down toward the thighs
machine-crunch.hard: the end of the crunch: torso curled forward with the ribs pulled toward the pelvis, the spine rounded, hips still on the seat, hands still beside the head
machine-crunch.sidePath: an arc in front of the chest and face that curves forward and down toward the thighs, its head pointing down toward the knees
machine-crunch.seqNote: a true profile: the mannequin faces the right edge of the picture; in the RIGHT panel the trunk is clearly curled: the ribcage pulled down toward the pelvis, the upper back rounded like the letter C, the head and shoulders well forward and down (about 30 to 45 degrees of trunk flexion), while the hips stay on the seat and the thighs stay level
machine-crunch.machineNote: the two handles sit just above the top of the back pad, one on each side of where the user's head goes, at the ends of a lever arm that pivots above and behind the back pad; the handles stay close to the back pad, never out in front of it like a chest press; the padded foot rollers sit low in front of the seat

cable-crunch.name: Kneeling cable crunch
cable-crunch.machine: a single cable column with the pulley carriage set at the TOP and a rope attachment
cable-crunch.setup: kneeling facing the column about an arm's length away, hips high over the knees, holding the rope ends beside the forehead
cable-crunch.start: torso tall and slightly arched, hips over the knees, rope by the head
cable-crunch.end: torso curled down so the elbows reach toward the thighs, spine rounded, hips still over the knees rather than sitting back
cable-crunch.path: the head and elbows curl down in an arc toward the thighs

decline-sit-up.name: Decline sit-up
decline-sit-up.setup: lying back on a decline bench that slopes DOWN toward the head: the feet hooked under the rollers at the HIGH end, the head at the LOW end, knees bent, arms crossed on the chest
decline-sit-up.start: torso lying back along the bench
decline-sit-up.path: a curved arrow beside the chest that starts where the shoulders lie and curves up and forward toward the knees (toward the upper right of the picture), its head pointing at the knees
decline-sit-up.seqNote: in both panels the HIGH end of the bench, with the foot rollers, is on the RIGHT and the LOW end is on the LEFT, so in the LEFT panel the lying head is clearly lower than the knees

bicycle-crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle-crunch.setup: lying on the back on the floor, hands lightly behind the head, legs raised
bicycle-crunch.start: shoulders lifted slightly, both knees bent 90 degrees above the hips
bicycle-crunch.end: torso rotated so the right elbow moves toward the left knee while the right leg extends straight
bicycle-crunch.path: the right elbow arcs across toward the left knee

mcgill-curl-up.name: McGill curl-up
mcgill-curl-up.setup: lying on the back, one knee bent with the foot flat and the other leg straight, hands under the lower back
mcgill-curl-up.start: head and shoulders resting on the floor
mcgill-curl-up.end: head and shoulders lifted slightly off the floor as one unit, neck not bending
mcgill-curl-up.path: a short upward arrow above the shoulders

captains-chair-knee-raise.name: Captain's chair knee raise
captains-chair-knee-raise.machine: a captain's chair (vertical knee raise station): a tall upright frame with a vertical back pad, two horizontal padded forearm rests with grip handles at elbow height, and a step at the bottom, no weights
captains-chair-knee-raise.setup: back against the pad, forearms on the arm rests, hands on the handles, feet off the step, legs hanging
captains-chair-knee-raise.start: legs hanging straight down, back against the pad
captains-chair-knee-raise.end: knees raised to hip height or higher with the pelvis tucked under, lower back curling slightly off the pad
captains-chair-knee-raise.path: the knees rise in an arc toward the chest
captains-chair-knee-raise.hard: the top: knees raised above hip height, thighs past level, pelvis tucked under so the lower back curls slightly off the pad, shoulders down on the arm rests

reverse-crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse-crunch.setup: lying on the back on a flat bench, hands holding the bench behind the head, knees bent 90 degrees
reverse-crunch.start: thighs vertical above the hips, knees bent
reverse-crunch.end: hips curled up off the bench, knees toward the chest
reverse-crunch.path: a curved arrow just above the knees: its tail starts at the knees and it curves toward the chest and head, to the LEFT of the picture, its head pointing at the chest: the knees travel toward the chest as the hips curl up off the bench
reverse-crunch.seqNote: the head lies at the LEFT end of the bench in both panels and the knees point up; in the RIGHT panel the hips are clearly lifted off the bench and the knees are over the chest

hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging leg raise
hanging-leg-raise.setup: hanging from a pull-up bar with straight arms, overhand grip at shoulder width
hanging-leg-raise.end: straight legs raised to level with the floor or higher, pelvis tucked
hanging-leg-raise.path: the feet swing up in an arc to hip height

ab-wheel-rollout.name: Ab wheel rollout
ab-wheel-rollout.setup: kneeling on a pad, hands on the handles of an ab wheel on the floor under the shoulders
ab-wheel-rollout.start: hips over the knees, wheel under the shoulders, back flat
ab-wheel-rollout.end: wheel rolled forward so the body forms a long straight line from knees to head, hips not sagging, ribs down
ab-wheel-rollout.path: the wheel rolls forward along the floor

pallof-press.name: Pallof press
pallof-press.camera: three-quarter front, away from the column
pallof-press.sideCamera: three-quarter front view from the side away from the cable column: the camera stands in front of the mannequin and about 45 degrees to its LEFT, at chest height; the cable column stands at the mannequin's RIGHT side, at the right edge of the picture and a little behind the mannequin, so the cable runs from the column across to the hands and the direction the chest faces points toward the lower left of the picture
pallof-press.machine: a single cable column with the pulley carriage set at chest height and a single stirrup handle
pallof-press.setup: standing side-on to the column with the column at the mannequin's RIGHT side, feet shoulder-width, knees soft, a step away so the cable is taut; both hands hold the single handle against the breastbone
pallof-press.start: hands holding the handle against the breastbone, elbows bent and tucked in, the cable running sideways from the column to the hands; chest, hips and feet square to the front, the direction the mannequin faces (toward the lower left of the picture)
pallof-press.end: arms pressed straight out in FRONT of the chest, in the direction the chest faces (toward the lower left of the picture), at a right angle to the cable: the cable and the straight arms form an L at the hands; the hands do NOT move toward or away from the column; chest and hips still square to the front, never turned toward the column
pallof-press.path: from the breastbone straight forward along the forearms in the direction the chest faces, at a right angle to the cable
pallof-press.hard: arms fully extended straight in front of the chest at a right angle to the cable, the cable pulling the hands sideways toward the column at the right edge, chest, hips and feet square to the front, knees soft
pallof-press.sidePath: from the breastbone straight forward along the arms in the direction the chest faces, its head at the hands
pallof-press.seqNote: the reference picture is this exercise's own side view: keep its camera, its cable column at the right edge and its stance, and draw that same mannequin in both panels; the RIGHT panel matches the reference pose, both arms straight out in front of the chest in the direction the chest faces (toward the left of the picture); in the LEFT panel the two hands hold the handle against the breastbone with the elbows bent and tucked; in both panels the cable runs from the pulley all the way to the handle in the hands, and the chest, hips and feet face the same way, never turned toward the column

cable-woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cable-woodchop.machine: a single cable column with the pulley carriage set at the TOP and a single stirrup handle
cable-woodchop.setup: standing side-on to the column, feet wider than the shoulders, both hands on the handle up by the shoulder nearest the pulley
cable-woodchop.start: arms extended up toward the high pulley, torso turned toward the column
cable-woodchop.end: arms pulled diagonally down and across the body to the outside of the far knee, torso rotated away, pivoting on the back foot
cable-woodchop.path: a diagonal downward arc across the body

rotary-torso-machine.name: Rotary torso machine
rotary-torso-machine.machine: a seated pin-loaded rotary torso machine: a seat that turns with knee pads that hold the legs, an upright chest pad with handles, a starting-angle selector, a weight stack
rotary-torso-machine.setup: seated with the knees between the pads, chest against the pad, arms on the handles
rotary-torso-machine.start: hips turned to one side with the seat, torso facing forward
rotary-torso-machine.end: hips and seat turned to the other side, torso still facing forward
rotary-torso-machine.path: a horizontal arc of the knees

leg-press-45.name: 45-degree leg press
leg-press-45.machine: a 45-degree plate-loaded sled leg press: a reclined padded seat and back pad, a large foot platform on a sled that slides up and down 45-degree rails, weight plates on horns on the sled, safety stop handles at the sides
leg-press-45.setup: lying back in the seat, feet on the platform about shoulder width apart in its middle, hands on the side handles, safety stops released
leg-press-45.start: knees bent about 90 degrees, thighs toward the chest, hips and lower back still flat on the pad
leg-press-45.end: legs pressed out to almost straight, knees not locked, the sled pushed up the rails

seated-leg-press.name: Seated leg press
seated-leg-press.machine: a seated pin-loaded horizontal leg press: an upright adjustable seat and back pad, a vertical foot plate in front, side handles, a weight stack
seated-leg-press.setup: back against the pad, feet flat on the foot plate about shoulder width apart, hands on the side handles
seated-leg-press.end: legs pushed out nearly straight, knees not locked
seated-leg-press.path: straight out away from the seat
seated-leg-press.seqNote: both panels show the same machine from the same side, never mirrored: the seat and back pad on the LEFT, the foot plate on the RIGHT, the mannequin facing the right edge in both panels; only the legs change

hack-squat.name: Hack squat machine
hack-squat.machine: a plate-loaded hack squat: an angled sled with shoulder pads and a back pad running on rails at about 45 degrees, a large angled foot platform at the bottom, weight plates on horns on the sled
hack-squat.setup: back flat against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet about shoulder width on the platform
hack-squat.start: knees bent deeply, thighs about parallel to the platform, back flat on the pad
hack-squat.end: legs extended, standing up along the rails, knees not locked

v-squat.name: V-squat machine
v-squat.machine: a plate-loaded V-squat: an angled foot platform, padded shoulder yokes on a long lever arm that pivots behind, weight plates on a horn on the lever
v-squat.setup: standing on the platform under the shoulder pads, feet about shoulder width
v-squat.start: knees and hips bent, thighs about parallel to the platform
v-squat.end: standing up with the legs straight, knees not locked
v-squat.path: the shoulder pads rise in a gentle arc

belt-squat.name: Belt squat machine
belt-squat.machine: a plate-loaded belt squat machine: a raised standing platform, a hip belt hanging from a chain on a lever arm loaded with plates, handrails in front
belt-squat.setup: standing on the platform with the belt around the hips, hands on the front rails
belt-squat.start: hips and knees bent, thighs about parallel to the floor, torso upright

goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.setup: standing with feet a little wider than the shoulders, holding one dumbbell vertically against the chest with both hands
goblet-squat.start: deep squat, thighs at or below parallel, elbows inside the knees, torso upright, heels down

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian-split-squat.setup: rear foot resting laces-down on a bench behind, front foot a long step forward, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides
bulgarian-split-squat.start: front thigh about parallel to the floor, back knee near the floor, torso upright
bulgarian-split-squat.end: front leg straightened, standing up on the front leg

smith-squat.name: Smith machine squat
smith-squat.machine: a Smith machine: a barbell fixed on two vertical steel guide rails with rack hooks and safety stops, the bar set at upper-chest height
smith-squat.setup: bar across the upper back, feet about shoulder width and slightly in front of the bar
smith-squat.start: squatted down, thighs about parallel to the floor, back straight
smith-squat.path: straight up along the guide rails

barbell-back-squat.name: Barbell back squat
barbell-back-squat.setup: bar on the upper back, feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out
barbell-back-squat.start: squatted down, thighs about parallel, torso leaning slightly forward, heels down, bar over the middle of the feet
barbell-back-squat.end: standing tall, hips and knees straight
barbell-back-squat.path: straight up over the middle of the feet

leg-extension.name: Leg extension machine
leg-extension.machine: a seated pin-loaded leg extension machine: a seat with an adjustable back pad, a padded roller on a lever arm in front of the shins with the pivot level with the knees, side handles, a weight stack
leg-extension.setup: back pad set so the knee joint lines up with the machine's pivot; the roller on the shins just above the ankles; hands on the side handles
leg-extension.start: knees bent about 90 degrees, feet under the front edge of the seat
leg-extension.end: knees straightened, legs level with the floor, toes up
leg-extension.path: the shins swing up in an arc around the knees

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated leg curl machine
seated-leg-curl.machine: a seated pin-loaded leg curl: a seat with a back pad, a thigh pad that clamps down over the thighs just above the knees, a padded roller on a lever behind the lower calves with the pivot level with the knees, a weight stack
seated-leg-curl.setup: knees lined up with the pivot, thigh pad locked down on the thighs, the roller behind the lower calves just above the heels
seated-leg-curl.start: legs straight out in front, roller behind the lower calves
seated-leg-curl.end: knees bent fully, heels pulled down and back under the seat
seated-leg-curl.path: the lower legs swing down and back in an arc around the knees

lying-leg-curl.name: Lying leg curl machine
lying-leg-curl.machine: a lying (prone) pin-loaded leg curl: an angled bench to lie face down on, handles at the front, a padded roller on a lever behind the ankles with the pivot level with the knees, a weight stack
lying-leg-curl.setup: lying face down, knees just off the end of the pad and in line with the pivot, roller on the back of the ankles, hands on the handles
lying-leg-curl.start: legs straight, roller on the back of the ankles
lying-leg-curl.end: knees bent, heels curled toward the glutes, hips pressed into the pad
lying-leg-curl.path: the heels curl up in an arc around the knees

nordic-hamstring-curl.name: Nordic hamstring curl
nordic-hamstring-curl.setup: kneeling on a pad with the ankles held down under a fixed bar or roller, body straight from knees to head
nordic-hamstring-curl.end: leaning forward as one straight line from knees to head, lowering slowly toward the floor, hands ready to catch
nordic-hamstring-curl.path: the straight body tips forward in an arc around the knees

trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
trap-bar-deadlift.setup: standing inside a hexagonal trap bar loaded with plates on the floor, feet hip-width, hands on the side handles
trap-bar-deadlift.start: hips back and down, knees bent, back flat, arms straight, shoulders over the handles, plates on the floor
trap-bar-deadlift.end: standing tall, hips and knees straight, bar at arm's length beside the thighs
trap-bar-deadlift.seqNote: the trap bar's two sleeves and plates stick out to the mannequin's LEFT and RIGHT, one plate beside each leg; the mannequin stands in the middle of the hexagonal frame and grips the two side handles, which run front to back beside the legs; the bar never runs front to back past the shins

dumbbell-rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell-rdl.setup: standing tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, knees soft
dumbbell-rdl.start: hips pushed back, torso hinged forward to about 45 to 60 degrees, back flat, dumbbells at mid-shin close to the legs, knees soft
dumbbell-rdl.end: standing tall, hips forward, dumbbells in front of the thighs
dumbbell-rdl.path: the dumbbells rise straight up close to the legs

barbell-rdl.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
barbell-rdl.setup: standing tall, feet hip-width, overhand grip on a barbell just outside the thighs, knees soft
barbell-rdl.start: hips pushed back, torso hinged forward to about 45 to 60 degrees, back flat, bar at mid-shin close to the legs
barbell-rdl.end: standing tall, hips forward, bar at the thighs
barbell-rdl.path: the bar rises straight up close to the legs

cable-pull-through.name: Cable pull-through
cable-pull-through.machine: a single cable column with the pulley carriage at the LOWEST position and a rope attachment
cable-pull-through.setup: standing facing away from the column, straddling the cable, holding the rope between the legs with both hands, two steps forward
cable-pull-through.start: hips hinged back, torso forward about 45 degrees, rope pulled back between the legs, back flat
cable-pull-through.end: hips driven forward to standing tall, arms straight, glutes squeezed
cable-pull-through.path: a curved arrow at the hips that drives them forward and up, AWAY from the cable column behind the mannequin, its head pointing away from the column, toward the way the mannequin faces

conventional-deadlift.name: Conventional deadlift
conventional-deadlift.setup: barbell on the floor over the middle of the feet, feet hip-width, hands gripping the bar just outside the knees
conventional-deadlift.start: hips back, back flat, shins touching the bar, shoulders slightly in front of the bar, arms straight
conventional-deadlift.end: standing tall with the bar at the thighs, hips and knees straight
conventional-deadlift.path: straight up close to the legs

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
kettlebell-swing.setup: standing with feet wider than the hips, holding a kettlebell with both hands
kettlebell-swing.start: hips hinged back, kettlebell swung back between the legs, forearms against the inner thighs, back flat
kettlebell-swing.end: hips snapped forward to standing tall, arms straight out in front at chest height holding the kettlebell
kettlebell-swing.path: the kettlebell swings forward and up in an arc to chest height

machine-hip-thrust.name: Hip thrust machine
machine-hip-thrust.machine: a plate-loaded hip thrust machine: a padded back rest for the upper back, a padded lever pad across the hips, a foot platform, weight plates on horns
machine-hip-thrust.setup: upper back on the back rest, the hip pad across the hip crease, feet flat about hip width on the platform, knees bent
machine-hip-thrust.start: hips lowered below the level of the knees
machine-hip-thrust.end: hips driven up until the body is a straight line from shoulders to knees, shins vertical, chin tucked

barbell-hip-thrust.name: Barbell hip thrust
barbell-hip-thrust.setup: upper back against the edge of a flat bench, a padded barbell across the hips, feet flat about hip width, knees bent
barbell-hip-thrust.end: hips driven up until the body is a straight line from shoulders to knees, shins vertical

glute-kickback-machine.name: Glute kickback machine
glute-kickback-machine.machine: a glute kickback machine: a standing frame with a chest pad and handles, a padded foot plate on a lever behind the working leg, a weight stack
glute-kickback-machine.setup: standing with the chest on the pad, holding the handles, the working foot on the foot plate
glute-kickback-machine.start: working hip and knee bent, the thigh forward under the hip
glute-kickback-machine.end: working leg pushed back and up until the hip is straight
glute-kickback-machine.path: the foot plate is pushed back and up in an arc

hip-abduction-machine.name: Hip abduction machine
hip-abduction-machine.machine: a seated pin-loaded hip abduction machine: a reclined seat with a back pad, two padded leg pads on levers on the outside of the knees, foot rests, a weight stack
hip-abduction-machine.setup: seated with the back against the pad, feet on the foot rests, the outside of the knees against the pads
hip-abduction-machine.end: knees pushed wide apart against the pads
hip-abduction-machine.path: a single curved arrow beside the knee on the right of the picture, curving outward away from the other knee, its head pointing away from the body

hip-adduction-machine.name: Hip adduction machine
hip-adduction-machine.machine: a seated pin-loaded hip adduction machine: a reclined seat with a back pad, two padded leg pads on levers on the inside of the knees, foot rests, a weight stack
hip-adduction-machine.setup: seated with the back against the pad, feet on the foot rests, the inside of the knees against the pads
hip-adduction-machine.path: in the open gap between the knees, one short arrow starting at the inside of each knee and pointing toward the middle of the machine, the two heads facing each other with a small space between them: the knees travel toward each other as the legs squeeze together; no arrow outside the knees
hip-adduction-machine.seqNote: in the LEFT panel the two leg pads sit INSIDE the spread knees, between the legs, each pad touching the inner side of its knee, so the two arrows lie in the open space between the two pads; in the RIGHT panel the pads have swung together and meet in the middle between the closed knees

copenhagen-adduction.name: Copenhagen adduction
copenhagen-adduction.setup: side plank on the forearm with the inside of the top leg's knee or ankle resting on a flat bench, the bottom leg under the bench
copenhagen-adduction.start: hips lowered toward the floor, bottom leg hanging below the bench
copenhagen-adduction.end: hips raised so the body forms a straight line, the bottom leg lifted to touch the underside of the bench
copenhagen-adduction.path: a short upward arrow under the hips

standing-calf-raise-machine.name: Standing calf raise machine
standing-calf-raise-machine.machine: a standing pin-loaded calf raise machine: padded shoulder yokes on a lever, a raised foot step block beneath, side handles, a weight stack
standing-calf-raise-machine.setup: shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the edge of the step, knees straight but not locked, body upright
standing-calf-raise-machine.start: heels lowered below the step, a deep stretch in the calves
standing-calf-raise-machine.end: heels raised as high as possible onto the balls of the feet

leg-press-calf-raise.name: Leg press calf raise
leg-press-calf-raise.machine: a 45-degree plate-loaded sled leg press: a reclined seat, a foot platform on a sled on 45-degree rails, weight plates on horns, safety handles
leg-press-calf-raise.setup: seated in the leg press with the legs straight but the knees not locked, only the balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the platform
leg-press-calf-raise.start: ankles flexed, toes pulled back toward the shins, heels below the platform edge
leg-press-calf-raise.end: ankles pointed, pushing the platform up with the balls of the feet
leg-press-calf-raise.path: the platform moves a short way up the rails
leg-press-calf-raise.seqNote: the legs are STRAIGHT in BOTH panels (knees soft, never bent like a leg press) and the sled is already pressed up the rails; only the ankles move: in the LEFT panel the heels sink below the platform edge, in the RIGHT panel the ankles point and the platform has moved a short way further up

single-leg-dumbbell-calf-raise.name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
single-leg-dumbbell-calf-raise.setup: standing on one foot on the edge of a step, a dumbbell in the same-side hand, the other hand on a support, the free foot behind the working ankle
single-leg-dumbbell-calf-raise.end: heel raised as high as possible

seated-calf-raise-machine.name: Seated calf raise machine
seated-calf-raise-machine.machine: a plate-loaded seated calf raise: a seat, a padded knee lever resting on the lower thighs, a foot step block, weight plates on a horn at the lever's end, a safety release handle
seated-calf-raise-machine.setup: seated, knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the step
seated-calf-raise-machine.end: heels raised as high as possible, lifting the knee pad
seated-calf-raise-machine.path: the knee pad rises straight up
